Hi Alex — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on SLOs and the customer-led load test: 

Summary of SLOs you shared:
- 95th p99 latency target: < 250ms for simple generation requests (prompt+response under 1k tokens)
- Sustained throughput: 120 reqs/s with up to 300 concurrent short requests during peak spikes
- Streaming support: required for streaming partial tokens to the client (we'll validate chunking behavior)
- Retry/backoff expectations: 429s should be treated as throttle signals, prefer client-side exponential backoff

Proposed next steps:
1) We provision a temporary test account and API key for FinWise (scoped to test endpoints).
2) Your infra team runs the k6/Locust scripts you prefer (we can share k6 starter script).
3) Allowlist Redwood test IP ranges for the test window (see below).
4) Execute a customer-led load test during a 2-hour window next Wednesday (Nov 25) 09:00–11:00 PT — we’ll monitor from our side and stand by for on-call support.

We attached a k6 starter script (k6_finwise_v1.js) and a short doc with provisioning instructions. Can you confirm: test window works? any changes to targets? who should receive the API key and the allowlist request from your side (name + email)?

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick sync if you prefer.

Marissa — adding technical details and a recommended k6 profile. TL;DR: we can support the targets but need to ensure the test uses realistic token sizes and respects streaming endpoints.

Provisioning
- I will create a scoped test API key (expires in 7 days) for FinWise and send it to Alan. Key will be limited to the test endpoints and rate-limited to protect prod capacity.

Recommended k6 profile (starter)
- Endpoint: https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate:stream and https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate for non-streaming
- Payload: median prompt ~ 80 tokens, max response up to 600 tokens (use the shorter prompt path for main throughput test)
- Stages:
  * ramp-up 5m to 120 vus
  * sustain 60m at 120 vus (this approximately matches 120 reqs/s depending on payload/latency)
  * spike stage 10m at 300 vus to simulate concurrency bursts
  * ramp-down 5m
- VU script: simple single-request per iteration, capture latency percentiles, and count streaming chunk messages separately
- For streaming verification: run a separate Locust scenario with 50 users simulating sustained streaming clients (each client opens a stream and receives tokens over 30–60s).

IP allowlist (please provide to FinWise infra):
- 34.82.112.0/24
- 34.83.200.0/24
- 35.199.80.0/24

Observability / safety knobs
- We will monitor p50/p95/p99 latencies and 429 rates in realtime. If 429s spike >1% for >5m we’ll pause the test and coordinate mitigations.
- Please keep us on the FinWise side in the loop for any mid-test changes to payloads.

Attachments and links
- Uploaded starter k6 script to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1A2b3FinWise-loadtests (k6_finwise_v1.js)
- I’ll send the API key to Alan directly and copy you.
